string-array.name: xtra5_shortcuts
string-array.item: Items marked [TV] need the setting Enable TV mode shortcuts. They work with a TV remote, keyboard or game controller.
- Back on a section\'s main page (Following, Games...): goes to Following > Live and refreshes it. Back on Live exits the app.
- [TV] Hold OK with no video, or with the video minimized: refreshes every section of the screen.
- Following, pressed again on Following\'s main page: switches to Live, refreshes it and scrolls to the top (already on Live: refreshes and scrolls to the top).
- Tap the Live tab: refreshes the Live list and scrolls to the top.
- Long-press a stream card: opens the stream in audio-only, just this once (your quality setting isn\'t changed).

- Long-press a streamer\'s profile picture: adds or removes them as a favourite (gold ring and star) and lists them first in Live. Shared with Following > Channels: favouriting here shows the ring and star there too, and vice versa.

- Long-press a profile picture: adds or removes the channel as a favourite. Shared with Following > Live: favouriting here shows the ring and star there and moves them to the top of Live, and vice versa.
- Left / Right: skip back / forward and show the seek bar (VODs, clips, downloads). While it shows, Left / Right keep skipping, Up moves to the player buttons and Back hides the controls.
- Up: shows the controls and takes hold of the seek bar (live streams: just shows the controls).
-- Left / Right: moves the marker; hold to keep moving.
Setting: Seek bar jump (% of video length)
-- Up: lets go (jumping there if the marker moved) and selects the right-most player button above the seek bar. Selecting the seek bar again (Down) takes hold of it again.
-- Back: cancels the move (also cancels by itself after 6 seconds). If the marker hasn\'t moved, hides the controls.
-- After jumping, while the controls are still showing: Left / Right skip by the seek step, Up moves to the player buttons, Back hides the controls.
- Down: opens Chapters, if the VOD has any. On a live stream: shows or hides the chat.
- Hold OK on a live stream: reloads the stream (like Restart player).
- Tap a paused mini player: resumes it.
- Tap an emote: shows the emote\'s details.
- Long-press an emote: puts it in your message (not sent; the chat input appears if it was hidden).
- Long-press a message or name: adds the chatter to your default highlight group, or takes them out.
- Long-press a saved color: removes it.
